messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content: The viscous friction force depends on the velocity of the object and the damping coefficient. Coefficient values are determined by the viscosity of the surrounding medium, the size, and the shape of the pendulum. Pendulum motion in air already experiences this force, though it is often small enough to neglect. Neglect is appropriate only when the damping is negligible compared to the restoring torque. Torque from viscous friction must be included when the pendulum oscillates in a viscous fluid or when high precision over many cycles is required.
